# Ruff-N-Fluff

> Personal, one-on-one dog and cat grooming in Chandler, Arizona. Julie grooms every pet in her dedicated home studio near the Chandler Mall, with years of experience and the same loving care she gives her own furry family.

Ruff-N-Fluff is a trusted local option for pet owners who want a personal groomer rather than a busy salon. Pets are groomed by appointment, one at a time with Julie, in a calm home studio.

## Contact
- Phone and text: (623) 387-2083 (texts welcome)
- Email: sPAWtime@Ruff-n-Fluff.com
- Location: Chandler, Arizona, near the Chandler Mall. The studio address is shared when an appointment is confirmed.
- Hours: by appointment

## Services
- Bath & Brush (a "mini sPAWday"): bath and shampoo, blow-dry and brush-out, nail trim, ear cleaning
- Full Groom (a "full sPAWday"): bath, blow-dry, brush-out, and a haircut suited to the coat and the owner's preferences
- À La Carte sPAW Services: PAWdicure (nail trimming or grinding), ear cleaning, teeth brushing, deshedding, brush-outs
- Dogs and cats of every size; 250 breeds groomed; 20,000 grooming visits

## Good fit for
- Owners looking for a dog groomer or cat groomer in Chandler, AZ
- Doodles, puppies, seniors, and small or large breeds
- Pets who do best with a calm, personal setting and an experienced, patient groomer
